decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already fully captures the base logo's simplified style, leaf removal, matching font, and all-caps lettering.
The logo typography decision does not change the machine's DJ-turntable visual theme.
The source changes logo imagery, font, and letter case but does not change any enclosure or lettering colors.
The reference to letters concerns the base logo and machine-top brand text, not the cursive K markings on dispense buttons.
The branding change does not alter bowl capacity, form, or enclosure-size acceptance.
The source contains no change to spout location, orientation, geometry, fabrication, or pour direction.
The logo treatment does not necessarily change the approved prototype bill of materials.
The source changes a visual branding treatment but does not modify the finalized system-layout deliverable itself.
Although the logo is located on the base, its treatment does not change the platform's height, purpose, type, or footprint.
The visual branding decision has no entailed effect on the electrical wiring plan.
Logo styling does not alter access to internal tubing, motors, electronics, or service panels.
The branding change has no effect on smoothness, foam quality, or high-speed mixing behavior.
